refine-sheet writes one sheet of the open records that miss criteria inside the git folder, and apply-sheet applies the filled sheet in one command, refusing the whole sheet and naming each empty or unknown id.
The definition of ready stays enforced: on the 20-issue beads sample, one filled sheet and one apply make every workable record ready (terminal baseline 2026-11-20: 0 of 19 ready).
apply-sheet reports the records it shaped and, separately, the records the scheduler lists as ready (terminal H1: 19 shaped, 16 ready).
An imported in_progress record with no holder is kept out of ready and listed as in progress elsewhere, to be adopted with a claim (terminal H2).
